title: Raven - Vanilla Enhanced
description: A collection of vanilla plus mods and resource packs, which enhance every feature of vanilla Minecraft!
body: The Minecraft Enhanced modpack, aims to enhance the core features of what makes vanilla Minecraft special, with a huge focus around exploration, refurbished structures and various overhauls to the sound system and world generation of Minecraft, while fixing issues in the base game, as well as adding many quality of life updates!
